entries.name: ESCO occupations and skills classification
entries.versionBasis: Official versions page says December 2025; official API page footer specifies last update 10/12/2025. This is classification version, not API release v6.0.0.

licence.basis: Official FAQ permits classification download/use/reproduction/reuse under Decision 2011/833/EU. Preserve attribution and identify modifications; API software EUPL-1.2 is a separate artifact.

norn.overlap: Source occupation/skill URIs and multilingual labels; not proof that tenant job titles or competencies are equivalent.

priority.reason: HR and payroll come after the commerce and ledger core.

entries.notes: Selector URL is a verified acquisition route, not an immutable payload pin. Package-level notices still need inspection before admission. Redistribution: license-conditions.

entries.name: HR Open Standards: recruiting, common employee data, payroll and timecard
entries.versionBasis: Actual TimecardType JSON declares version 4.3.0 despite being served under /4.5R/. Official documentation labels suite 4.5 Approved and 4.6 Release Candidate; this does not change the file's version. May 9, 2025 announcement is candidate, not final approval date.

licence.basis: Agreement sections 2(a,c-e) permit reproduction and derivatives with agreement and notices; 2(f) restricts standards-organization derivatives and section 7 requires commercial indemnity. Applicability to Norn registry derivatives requires review.

norn.overlap: Employee/contact/pay components and time events are source shapes, never a global payroll policy or Core authority.

priority.reason: HR and payroll come after the commerce and ledger core.

entries.notes: Actual JSON schema verified, but path uses hros-timecard-dev: correspondence with approved 4.5 distribution is unverified. Payroll/recruiting/common schema directories and samples are discoverable, not certified as a complete approved corpus. PDF is rights evidence only, not a standards source payload. Redistribution: unverified.

entries.name: ISCO-08 structure and group definitions
entries.versionBasis: ILO records adoption December 2007, endorsement March 2008; exact workbook publication date unverified. 2021 path is not a release date.

licence.basis: Artifact-specific reuse grant not verified; do not transfer a modern ILO publication licence to this older workbook by assumption.

norn.overlap: Occupation identifiers and classification hierarchy; not employee records or payroll rules.

priority.reason: HR and payroll come after the commerce and ledger core.

entries.notes: Machine-readable workbook is documented but bytes inaccessible in this check; the PDF volume is not substituted. Redistribution: unverified.

entries.name: O*NET 31.0 Database
entries.publisher: US Department of Labor / National Center for O*NET Development
entries.versionBasis: Official database archive lists 31.0 August 2026; verified ZIP header. Do not infer a specific day.

licence.basis: Database content licence permits copying/adaptation with USDOL/ETA and version attribution, licence link and change indication; trademark and listed exceptions remain. Does not cover career-exploration tools or all site content.

norn.overlap: US occupations, work activities and skills; US taxonomy is enrichment, not Egypt employment authority.

priority.reason: HR and payroll come after the commerce and ledger core.
